prompt: Detect and map the ORM entities in this Python project that uses SQLAlchemy with PostgreSQL. The project has a single models.py file declaring multiple entities that inherit from a shared declarative Base.

assertions.text: Every class that inherits from the declarative Base is identified as an entity
Each entity's table_name matches its own __tablename__ assignment (R3 per-class windowing)
relationship() declarations have type AND target_entity populated (T1)
ForeignKey() declarations resolve to a target table name (not 'table.column') (T1)
detected-entities.json serializes each relationship as {type, target_entity} (T2, not a bare kind string)
Mermaid erDiagram has edges between real tables (users↔orders, users↔roles) with NO _rel placeholders
